title: REQ · Run blocks at the approval gate before publishing unless auto-publish is on
summary: After a successful agent run Run publishes only with AutoPublish, otherwise stops as AWAITING_APPROVAL
description: Context: store.StatusAwaitingApproval and Config.AutoPublish exist. Desired behavior: on agent success, if AutoPublish is false Run saves status AWAITING_APPROVAL, keeps the worktree and does not call Publisher.Publish; if true it calls Publish and saves COMPLETED. Expected result: supervised publishing by default. Why: human approval of first releases.
acceptance_criteria: Given AutoPublish false and a successful agent, when Run is called, then the returned execution status is AWAITING_APPROVAL, the stored status matches, Publish is never called and Worktrees.Remove is not called
Given AutoPublish true and a successful agent, when Run is called, then Publish is called once with the worktree directory and status is COMPLETED
Given AutoPublish true and Publish returns an error, when Run is called, then the status is FAILED and the error is returned

in_scope: gate logic in Run's finish step
